add.label: Open a view
add.note: Opens a further view from a ViewSourceRef. Runs only inside a command the solver invoked; a view cannot open views. An open ViewId refuses with EV3:input.view_id_in_use.

add.label: Close a view
add.note: Closes a further view. Global, Local and an unknown view refuse with EV3:input.view_not_closable.

add.label: Start recording
add.note: Starts capture of resolved invocations, including refusals, excluding recording.*; a second start refuses with EV4:input.recording_state.

add.label: Stop recording
add.note: Ends capture and stores the recording; with no recording it refuses with EV4:input.recording_state.

add.label: Play a recording
add.note: Plays view and workspace steps unattended and never a commit. Stops and waits for one user action at commit-lane, confirm, file_check, file, app, exclusive-lane and job rows (EV4.18, PS1.44).

add.label: Convert a recording
add.note: Converts a recording to a draft or to source; a step with no form in the target refuses with EV4:input.recording_not_convertible.

add.label: Write workspace record
add.note: M6's record write: writes the named record's payload and provenance block as one durable action; the workspace revision and the record's version advance, and the state, the preview slot and the jobs stay. Undo and redo are workspace inverses. The host's provenance reader checks the block at the write. A program may not invoke it (LG3:capability.not_granted). OPEN: the payload's type Json is not frozen.
add.source: M6 record write; KN5.18, KN5.23, LI.26, PS1.16; joins H-08 at the LP3 freeze (PHS.53)
